title.en: Frequency and phase modulation (FM and PM)
title.kn: ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಂತ ಮಾಡ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ (FM ಮತ್ತು PM)

heading.en: Why does FM radio sound cleaner?

hook.en: Lightning and motors crackle on AM radio but hardly touch FM. The secret: FM hides the message in the frequency, where noise cannot easily reach it.
hook.kn: ಮಿಂಚು ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಟಾರುಗಳ ಗದ್ದಲ AM ರೇಡಿಯೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ, FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಷ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. FM ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಶಬ್ದ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ತಲುಪುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Define frequency deviation and FM modulation index
Find FM bandwidth by Carson's rule

narration.en: Lightning and motors crackle on AM radio but hardly touch FM. The secret: FM hides the message in the frequency, where noise cannot easily reach it.
narration.kn: ಮಿಂಚು ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಟಾರುಗಳ ಗದ್ದಲ AM ರೇಡಿಯೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ, FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಷ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. FM ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಶಬ್ದ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ತಲುಪುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: In FM the instantaneous frequency of the carrier varies in proportion to the instantaneous amplitude of the message, while the amplitude stays constant. The maximum shift from $f_c$ is the frequency deviation $\Delta f$. The modulation index is $m_f = \Delta f/f_m$, which can be greater than 1. An FM wave has many sidebands; by Carson's rule the bandwidth is $BW \approx 2(\Delta f + f_m)$. Broadcast FM (88–108 MHz) allows $\Delta f = 75$ kHz.

points.en: Δf ∝ message amplitude; rate of deviation = fm
Total power constant, independent of modulation

narration.en: In FM the carrier frequency follows the message and the amplitude stays constant. The modulation index is delta f by fm, and Carson's rule gives bandwidth two times delta f plus fm.
narration.kn: FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹಕದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಸಂದೇಶದ ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. mf = Δf/fm ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ ≈ 2(Δf + fm).

title.en: Phase modulation and AM vs FM

body.en: In PM the phase of the carrier is varied in proportion to the message amplitude; PM and FM are closely related (both are angle modulation). FM is generated, for example, by a varactor diode whose capacitance in the oscillator tank changes with the message. Compared with AM, FM has better noise immunity and fidelity and constant transmitted power, but needs much more bandwidth and more complex circuits, and works by line-of-sight (VHF).

points.en: FM: + noise immunity, + fidelity, + constant power
FM: − large bandwidth, − complex, − line-of-sight range

narration.en: Phase modulation varies the carrier phase. FM gives better noise immunity and fidelity than AM, but needs more bandwidth.
narration.kn: PM ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಹಕದ ಹಂತ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. AM ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದರೆ FM ಗೆ ಶಬ್ದ ನಿರೋಧಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಆದರೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ ಬೇಕು.

problem.en: An FM station has a maximum frequency deviation of 75 kHz and the highest audio frequency is 15 kHz. Find the modulation index and bandwidth. Compare with AM for the same audio.

steps.en: BW (AM) = 2fm = 30 kHz: FM needs six times more.

answer.en: mf = 5; BW = 180 kHz (AM would need 30 kHz)

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An FM station has a maximum frequency deviation of 75 kHz and the highest audio frequency is 15 kHz. Find the modulation index and bandwidth. Compare with AM for the same audio.

heading.en: FM, AM: what changes, what stays

body.en: In AM the amplitude moves and the frequency stays; in FM the frequency moves and the amplitude stays. So noise, which attacks amplitude, can be clipped off in FM but not in AM.

narration.en: In AM the amplitude moves and the frequency stays; in FM the frequency moves and the amplitude stays. So noise, which attacks amplitude, can be clipped off in FM but not in AM.

mnemonic.en: AM: Amplitude Moves. FM: Frequency Moves.

narration.en: Team quiz. Each team discusses and locks in one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಅಂತಿಮಗೊಳಿಸಲಿ.

points.en: FM varies the carrier frequency; amplitude stays constant.
points.kn: FM ವಾಹಕದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ.

points.en: PM varies the carrier phase; FM and PM are angle modulation.
FM has better noise immunity but needs more bandwidth than AM.
points.kn: FM ಗೆ ಶಬ್ದ ನಿರೋಧಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಆದರೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೇಕು.

homework.en: Write four differences between AM and FM.

narration.en: Recap. FM varies the carrier frequency; amplitude stays constant. mf = Δf/fm; Carson bandwidth = 2(Δf + fm). PM varies the carrier phase; FM and PM are angle modulation. FM has better noise immunity but needs more bandwidth than AM.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. FM ವಾಹಕದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ವೈಶಾಲ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ. mf = Δf/fm; ಕಾರ್ಸನ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ = 2(Δf + fm). PM ವಾಹಕದ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. FM ಗೆ ಶಬ್ದ ನಿರೋಧಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಆದರೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ವಿಡ್ತ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೇಕು.
